description: Vet a source: refresh its declared registry facts (RDAP registration and certificate transparency) through the source pack, read its reliability card with separately rated grades, pivot over organization-keyed infrastructure relations, and record the finding in the session.

source.description: Source name to vet (as carried by its documents)

identifier.description: The source's domain or source-identity id; person-keyed identifiers are refused

artifacts.description: Reliability card with Admiralty grades, cited registration and certificate history, and probable infrastructure relations with their caveat

questions: How reliable is ${source}, and which other sources share its registrant organization or certificates?
success_criteria: Every infrastructure hop cites the RDAP or certificate-transparency observation it comes from
Source reliability and information credibility are reported as separate axes
